title: UNICEF Youth Leadership Program
eligibility: Ages 15–25, residents of Egypt or Yemen
description: A comprehensive 3-month program equipping young leaders with tools to create positive change in their communities. Participants receive mentorship, workshops, and a small project grant to implement local solutions.

title: Arab Youth Leadership Summit
description: An annual gathering of young Arab leaders to share ideas, network, and collaborate on regional challenges. Features keynote speakers, workshops, cultural exchange, and networking sessions.

title: INJAZ Egypt Student Company Program
description: Students form real companies, develop business plans, and compete nationally. Develops entrepreneurship, teamwork, and presentation skills with mentorship from business professionals and corporate volunteers.

title: British Council YouthConnect Training
description: Free online training series on communication, digital skills, and career development. Participants receive a British Council certificate upon completion and access to a global alumni network.

title: UNDP Youth Volunteer Initiative
description: Join a network of youth volunteers working on sustainable development goals. Volunteer opportunities in education, environment, and community development across Egypt, with training and certificate.

title: Chevening Scholarship
eligibility: Egyptian or Yemeni nationals with 2+ years work experience
description: Fully funded scholarship for a one-year master's degree at a UK university. Covers tuition, living allowance, return flights, and visa costs. For future leaders with demonstrable leadership potential.

title: Mercy Corps Youth Program Yemen
description: Life skills and livelihood training program for Yemeni youth. Includes vocational training, soft skills workshops, and connections to employment opportunities in a safe, supportive environment.

title: Global Youth Innovation Challenge
description: Submit innovative solutions to global challenges including education, climate, and public health. Winners receive mentorship, global recognition, and seed funding to implement their ideas.

title: World Bank Youth Summit
description: Annual online summit bringing together young voices to discuss economic development, education, and sustainability alongside World Bank experts and policymakers from around the world.

title: Community Storytelling Workshop
eligibility: Open to all students and young people
description: A hands-on workshop teaching students to use storytelling as a tool for advocacy and community change. Run by local NGO trainers with years of experience working with Egyptian youth.

title: Amideast Professional Skills Training
description: Professional development training covering resume writing, interview preparation, networking, and workplace communication. Limited seats available. Conducted at Amideast offices in Cairo.

title: Youth Leadership Fellowship — MENA
description: Six-month fellowship connecting emerging leaders across the MENA region. Includes monthly mentorship from senior leaders, peer learning sessions, and a capstone community project with stipend support.
